record.notes: The document's footer reads 'MINICT - 2022'. MINICT lists it among the policies approved by the Cabinet, with the date 27 April 2023; the day of Cabinet approval is not given. Developed by MINICT and RURA with support from GIZ FAIR Forward, the Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution Rwanda (C4IR) and The Future Society. It is accompanied by tailored Guidelines on the Ethical Development and Implementation of AI, published by MINICT and RURA, and recommends a Responsible AI Office within MINICT in the policy's first year to lead implementation. Its implementation plan runs from FY 2023/24 to FY 2027/28.
record.scope_note: Mainly a policy for AI skills, infrastructure, data and adoption in the public and private sectors, with practical AI ethics guidelines as its one safeguard area; included as Rwanda's national AI policy.

verification.note: Recheck of 18 Oct 2026. Stored: the policy PDF and MINICT's publications page for policies, both from minict.gov.rw (11 Oct 2026). The PDF confirms the title, its development by MINICT and RURA and the content summarised; it carries no date other than the footer 'MINICT - 2022' and the implementation years FY 23/24 to FY 27/28. The publications page lists the 'Artificial Intelligence Policy' among the policies approved by the Cabinet with the date Apr 27, 2023, which is the basis of the April 2023 date; it does not give the date of Cabinet approval. That page was stored as the record's secondary source, so the date rests on another official source rather than on the policy itself.

judgment.status_reasoning: MINICT lists the policy among those approved by the Cabinet; its implementation plan runs from FY 2023/24 to FY 2027/28, so it is within its implementation period on 18 Oct 2026, and nothing stored shows it replaced or withdrawn. Published (non-binding, current).
judgment.scope_reasoning: A national AI policy with a safeguard area on practical AI ethics, regulator capacity building and responsible public-sector adoption; in scope, with a scope_note because its main focus is skills, infrastructure, data and adoption.
judgment.date_reasoning: The policy carries no publication date (footer 'MINICT - 2022'); MINICT's list of Cabinet-approved policies gives Apr 27, 2023 for the file. That date is a listing date rather than a stated adoption date, so the month is kept: 2023-04, as published.
